hooks.name: Regenerate Committed Plugin Artifacts
hooks.description: When a source input to the committed plugin artifacts changes (knowledge/, the claude-code skill template, or the bridge source), regenerate skills/ and bridge/mcp-server.cjs locally so drift never reaches CI. Reports what was regenerated for the developer to review and stage.

action.command: cd kanon && bun run build:skills && bun run build:bridge && if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain skills bridge)" ]; then echo "Regenerated committed plugin artifacts (skills/ and/or bridge/mcp-server.cjs). Review and stage the changes:"; git status --short skills bridge; else echo "Plugin artifacts already in sync — nothing to regenerate."; fi
